answer_1.quote: We propose a multi-step LLM-agent framework for Data Story Generation...
answer_1.outputs: multimodal data stories consisting of textual paragraphs and visualization specifications (e.g., chart type, axes, labels)

answer_2.quote: To assess the efficacy of the agentic framework for story generation, we used two rigorous evaluation methods: (i) automatic evaluation using Gemini-1.5-pro as an LLM-judge and (ii) human evaluation.

answer_3.quote: We implemented an automatic evaluation method i.e., pairwise comparison of the stories generated by the agentic framework versus direct prompting. The evaluation criteria included 'Informativeness', 'Clarity and Coherence', 'Visualization Quality', 'Narrative Quality', and 'Factual Correctness'.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation on 100 story samples generated by the top-performing model (GPT-4o). For each sample, two annotators performed a pairwise comparison between the two versions, ... The metrics include 'Informativeness', 'Clarity and Coherence', 'Visualization Quality', 'Narrative Quality', and 'Factual Correctness'.
